title: Synthetic Data Service
summary: A containerized FastAPI microservice that trains SDV models on user-supplied tabular data and serves privacy-safe synthetic samples on demand via a REST API, with Redis caching and PII replacement. It uses SDV's SingleTablePreset and SingleTableMetadata classes in app/data_generator.py to train and generate the synthetic data returned by the API.
evidence: app/data_generator.py:2-3: 'from sdv.single_table import SingleTablePreset' and 'from sdv.metadata import SingleTableMetadata'
needs: SingleTablePreset's underlying algorithm (e.g. FAST_ML) not specified in evidence, so exact synthesizer concept beyond metadata_schema is unconfirmed
